claim: The three steps of the bridge: Kuramoto is the phase-reduced shadow of any population of limit cycles — and it holds only as coupling goes to zero: on van der Pol μ=1 the shadow's locking range matches the full pair up to 0.1 and has parted by 0.4; at μ=0.3 it misses locking even at 0.05.

pieces.section: The three steps of the bridge
pieces.what: The full van der Pol pair beside its Kuramoto shadow, locking tongues drawn side by side, with μ and coupling sliders: watch the two agree at weak coupling and part as it grows. The gathered Dissolutions proof is this test.
pieces.walks_up_from: one van der Pol loop alone, kicked and settling back to its cycle

pieces.section: The three steps of the bridge
pieces.what: Build the PRC by hand: kick the oscillator at a chosen phase, measure the advance or delay, plot the point; sweep the kick and the curve draws itself.
pieces.walks_up_from: one limit cycle and its phase marker

pieces.what: Huygens' two clocks on one beam, heard as two ticks drifting then locking antiphase.
